strings.tip.001: Auctions start at 95% of NT. A calm bid often beats a fast one.
strings.tip.002: The auction fee is 2% of the final price. Budget for it.
strings.tip.003: NT = A x (1 + 0.10P + 0.005R) x M. Income and reputation raise value.
strings.tip.004: Payback tells you how many days a company needs to repay its price.
strings.tip.005: Purchased companies send 35% of gross income to your pocket.
strings.tip.006: Offline income waits for 8 hours. Log in twice a day to stay rich.
strings.tip.007: Leverage can fund a bid, but interest runs 8% per week.
strings.tip.008: Leverage is capped at 40% of the price and 2x your daily net income.
strings.tip.009: Salaries follow your tier, not your cash balance. Plan ahead.
strings.tip.010: Upgrades cost 15% more each level. Spread them across operations.
strings.tip.011: Each operation level lifts income 8-14%. Cheap levels first!
strings.tip.012: Sectors differ: app 1.15, logistics 1.00, fnb 0.90 multiplier.
strings.tip.013: Season multipliers (0.95-1.25) bend the whole market. Time your bids.
strings.tip.014: A company's synergy sector loves its neighbours. Watch the tags.
strings.tip.016: Lost a target? It returns in 48 hours. Set a reminder.
strings.tip.017: Legacy companies carry a 15-25% premium. They are worth the drama.
strings.tip.018: The Auction Boss hunts legacy giants. Bring deep pockets.
strings.tip.019: COO's Overtime finishes operations 30 minutes early. Every 6 hours.
strings.tip.020: CFO's Audit Clean refunds 50% of leverage interest. Save it for big loans.
strings.tip.021: CMO's Campaign adds +6 reputation over 48 hours. Once a week.
strings.tip.022: CTO's Market Scan shows exact NT for 24 hours. Bid with x-ray eyes.
strings.tip.023: HR's Recruitment grabs a 4-star hire at 3-star price. Monthly treat.
strings.tip.024: Research costs DP, not cash. Investors fund your brain.
strings.tip.025: Every research effect has a hard cap. No runaway multipliers here.
strings.tip.026: Daily contracts refresh every 24 hours. Free money for small tasks.
strings.tip.027: Weekly targets pay real DP. Stack them with contracts.
strings.tip.028: Market news bends income for a few hours. Read the ticker.
strings.tip.029: Premium season tracks sell comfort and cosmetics only. Fair play.
strings.tip.030: KM buys style, never power. Your rivals stay on equal ground.
strings.tip.031: The wishlist keeps market eyes on dream companies.
strings.tip.032: Auto-collect pulls your income once a day, even while asleep.
strings.tip.033: Your pocket league has 30 desks. Beat 29 bots, earn bragging rights.
strings.tip.034: Milestones pay DP. Check the list when you feel stuck.
strings.tip.035: Two sectors beat one: synergy bonuses love diversity.
strings.tip.036: A dual-tier empire mixes cheap payback with prestige value.
strings.tip.037: The starter grant is enough for your first T1 auction. Spend it.
strings.tip.038: The tutorial's first auction has no AI bids for 8 minutes. Relax.
strings.tip.039: TM is cash, DP is investor money, KM is style points.
strings.tip.040: Long paybacks at high tiers are normal. Empires are marathons.
